correctness.rationale: For finite ordered W_n and arbitrary R rows, threshold input upsets [a,n),[b,n) fail precisely at rows whose minimum t_j lies in [a,b), so the induced strict implication is [1+max_{a<=p<b}ell_p,n), ell_p being the last row attaining minimum p. These last occurrences are a partial injection and every injection is realized. Persistence J(A,B) subset J(top,J(A,B)) is equivalent to no two occupied rooks (p,i),(q,j) with i<j and q<=i. Backwards choosing labels in nested suffix sets yields A_n=1+sum_{k=1}^n(n-k+1)sum_{i_1<...<i_k}prod_{h=1}^{k-1}(n-k+h-i_h). Independent exhaustive row-minimum and all-valuation tests for n=1..5 reproduce 2,6,21,82,352; source code independently compares through n=6 and counts rook placements through n=8. The count is of induced operations, not raw relations.
